en: O foremost of men, bathing in it, you will be freed from all your sins. O son of Kunti, the celestials Rishis performed here the Sarasvata sacrifice; so did the Rishis and the royal sages.

sa: एह्येहि पाञ्चालि जितासि कृष्णे दुर्योधनं पश्य विमुक्तलज्जा। कुरून् भजस्वायतपत्रनेत्रे धर्मेण लब्धासि सभां परैहि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon she, being (much) distressed, rose up in great affliction, and covering her pale face with her hands, ran to the place where were the ladies of the old king, the foremost of the Kurus (Dhritarashtra.)

sa: योऽध्यापयेदधीयीत यजेद् वा याजयीत वा॥ दद्याद् वापि यथाशक्ति तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः।
en: Who himself studies and teaches others; and who, again, performs sacrifices himself and presides at the sacrifices performed by others, who gives away according to his means. The gods know him to be a Brahmana.

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच त्वं वै धर्मस्य विज्ञाता दैवस्येहासुरस्य च। ब्राह्मणस्य महाभाग धर्मकृच्छ्रमिदं शृणु॥
en: Prahlada said O exalted one, you are learned in the precepts of morality which should guide the celestial, the Asuras and the Brahmanas. Here is a great dilemma in respect of a duty. Hear it.

sa: लभ्यते खलु पापीयान् नरो नु प्रियवागिह। अप्रियस्य हि पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः॥
en: Many sinful men who speak agreeable words may be had in this world, but a man, who will speak words that are disagreeable through fit as regimen or a man who will hear such words, is very rare.

sa: गौतम उवाच जानामि नाहं मुह्यामि त्वमेवात्र विमुह्यते। स्तौषि त्वं दर्शनप्रेप्सू राजानं जनसंसदि॥
en: Gautama said: I am sure, it is not I but you who are labouring under a misconception in this matter. Desirous of obtaining his favour you are flattering the king before this assembly of men.

sa: यत्र संनिहितो नित्यं महादेवः पिनाकधृक्। तत्र ते पाण्डवा वीराश्चातुर्मास्यैस्तदेजिरे॥ ऋषियज्ञेन महता यत्राक्षयवटो महान्।
en: The wielder of Pinaka, the great god (Shiva) is always near it. The heroic Pandavas performed there the vow called Chaturmasa, according to the rites of the Rishi Jagma. Here is also the great banian tree called Akshayavata.

sa: तपोधर्मदमेज्याभिर्विप्रा यान्ति यथा दिवम्। दानातिथ्यक्रियाधमैर्यान्ति वैश्याच सद्गतिम्॥ क्षत्रं याति तथा स्वर्गं भुवि निग्रहपालनैः।
en: The Brahmanas go to heaven by ascetic merits, by controlling their senses and by performing sacrifices. The Vaishyas obtain the blessed state by gifts, hospitality and religious acts. The Kshatriyas go to heaven by protecting and punishing men.

sa: प्रियं सर्वे करिष्यामो राज्ञः किङ्करपाणयः। न चास्य शक्नुमः स्थातुं प्रिये सर्वे ह्यतन्द्रिताः॥
en: We all wait with joined hands like the servants of the king (Duryodhana). We must do what is agreeable to him. But we are not always able to seek his welfare with promptness and activity.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच वत्से शोको न ते कार्यः प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत्। स्त्रीधर्माणामभिज्ञासि शीलाचारवती तथा॥
en: Kunti said O child, do not grieve that this great calamity has overtaken you. You are well aware of all the duties of the female sex. Your character and conduct are as they should be.

sa: अमोघदर्शी भीष्माहं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते। यद् वक्ष्यसि कुरुश्रेष्ठ तस्य दातास्मि तेऽनघ॥
en: O Bhishma, my eyes can penetrate into everything. Tell me what I can do for you. O foremost of the Kuru race, O sinless one, I shall grant you whatever you will ask from me.

sa: ततो गोदावरी प्राप्य नित्यं सिद्धनिषेविताम्॥ गवां मेधमवाप्नोति वासुकेर्लोकमुत्तमम्। वेणायाः संगमे स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to the Godavari, always frequented by the Siddhas. One obtains the fruits of a cow-sacrifice and goes to the excellent region of Vasuki. Bathing at the confluence of Vena one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice.

sa: त्वया च वसुसम्भूतो महावीर्यः पितामहः। भीष्मः परमधर्मात्मा संसाध्यश्च रणेऽनघ॥ क्षत्रं चाग्निसमस्पर्श भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम्। दानवाश्च महावीर्या ये मनुष्यत्वमागताः॥ निवातकवचाश्चैव दानवाः कुरुनन्दन। पितुर्ममांशु देवस्य सर्वलोकप्रतापिनः॥ कर्णश्च सुमहावीर्यस्त्वया वध्योधनंजय।
en: O sinless one, by you shall be vanquished in battle the highly virtuous and powerful grandsire Bhishma, born of Vasus. (You shall also defeat) Kshatriyas of fiery energy protected by the son of Baradvaja as also the highly powerful Danavas who have been born among men. The Danavas named Nivatakavachas, O descendant of Kuru; and the highly powerful Karna, who is a portion of my father who lights all the regions, shall be slain by you.

sa: अन्यः कृतयुगे कालस्त्रेतायां द्वापरे परः। अयं प्रध्वंसन: कालो नाद्य तद् रूपमस्ति मे॥
en: In the Krita Yuga, the state of things was one, in the Treta another and in the Dvapara another. Diminution (of everything) is taking place in this age. I have (therefore) not that form today.

sa: वृष्णयः पाण्डुसुतान् समीक्ष्य भूमौ शयानान् मलदिग्धगावान्। ते ॥ अनर्हती द्रौपदों चापि दृष्ट्वा सुदुःखिताश्चक्रुशुरातनादम्॥
en: The Vrishnis saw that the sons of Pandu lay down on the ground, their bodies being besmeared all over with dirt. Seeing Draupadi in a sad state, they were filled with grief and broke out into loud lamentations.

sa: तथैव बहवोऽस्माभी राष्ट्रेभ्यो विप्रवासिताः॥ राजानो राजपुत्राश्चधृतराष्ट्रमनुव्रताः। न हि तेऽप्युपशाम्यन्ति निकृता वा निराकृताः॥
en: Then again many kings have been driven away from their kingdoms. These kings and princes will all follow the wicked son of Dhritarashtra. For robbed and exiled by us, they cannot be friendly towards us.

sa: आसाद्य भीमसेनं संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः। धार्तराष्ट्रा विनेदुर्हि नान्यामकथयन् कथाम्॥ परिवार्य रणे भीमं निजघ्नुस्ते समन्ततः।
en: Filled with rage and invincible in battle those heroes, belonging to your party, approached Bhimasena and cried aloud. They then spoke not to one another. Encircling Bhima in that battle, they began to strike him from all sides.

sa: स संनिपातस्तुमुलो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः॥ सात्यकिश्चैव शूरस्य मद्राणामधिपस्य च। यादृशो वै पुरा वृत्तः शम्बरामरराजयोः॥
en: The encounter between Satyaki and the heroic king of the Madras, became fierce and wonderful to look at like that which had taken place in the days of yore between the Asura Shambara and Indra.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यं महद् घोरं तीर्खा द्वादशवार्षिकम्। हिमवत्पार्श्वमास्थाय यो मया तपसार्जितः॥ समानव्रतचारिण्यां रुक्मिण्यां योऽन्वजायत। सनत्कुमारस्तेजस्वी प्रद्युम्नो नाम मे सुतः॥ तेनाप्येतन्महद् दिव्यं चक्रमप्रतिमं रणे। न प्रार्थितमभून्मूढ यदिदं प्रार्थितं त्वया॥
en: That son whom I got by practising ascetic penances and observing the austere Brahmacharya for twelve years on the Himavat where I had gone for the purpose, that son of mine, viz., the energetic Pradyumna a portion of Sanatkumara himself, begotten by me upon my wife Rukmini who had practised vows as austere as mine, that hero even never wanted this best of objects, viz., this peerless discus, which you foolish, as you are have wanted.

sa: नाहं त्वया समेष्यापि वृत्तो हेतुः समागमे॥ शिवं ध्यायस्व मे स्वस्थः सुकृतं स्मरसे यदि।
en: I shall not, therefore, make friendship with you. There is no reason any longer for such a union. If, indeed, you do not forget my good offices, think of what will be good for me and be comfortable.

sa: यस्मिन् विश्वानि भूतानि तिष्ठन्ति च विशन्ति च॥ गुणभूतानि भूतेशे सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।
en: All the worlds and all created things live in you and enter you at the time of dissolution. Like gems strung together in a thread, all things possessing attributes exist in you, the Supreme Lord.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यथादेशं यथाकालं यथाबुद्धि यथाबलम्। अनुशिष्यात् प्रजा राजा धर्मार्थी तद्धिते रतः॥
en: Bhishma said A king desirous of acquiring religious merit, should seek the good of his subjects and protect them according to considerations of place and time and to the best of his intelligence and power.

sa: न मे प्रियं यनिहताः संग्रामे मामकैनरैः। न च कुर्वन्ति मे वाक्यमुच्यमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Having defeated an army, the king should address the survivors saying-I am not at all glad that so many have been killed by my men. Alas, the latter, through repeatedly dissuaded by me, have not obeyed my orders.

sa: न ह्यनं नोदकं तस्य न स्नानं नाप्यशौचकम्॥ हतस्य कर्तुमिच्छन्ति तस्य लोकाशृणुष्व मे।
en: Men do not wish to give food and drink. Nor do they bathe nor enter into mourning for him. Listen to me as I describe the happiness that is in store for such a person.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच न भर्तुः शासनं वीरा रणे कुर्वन्त्यमर्षिताः॥ अलं क्रोधुमथैतेषां नायं काल उपेक्षितम्।
en: Sakuni said When worked up with rage in battle, brave warriors do not obcy the bchests of their leaders. You should not be angry with those men. This is not the time to act indifferently.

sa: इतीव संचिन्त्य सुरर्षिसंघाः सम्प्रस्थिता यान्ति यथा निकेतनम्। यथासुखं खं च महीतलं च॥
en: Thinking thus the host of gods and Rishis left the scene of action for their respective habitations. Other creatures also wended their way, as they liked, either for the celestial region or for the earth.

sa: उभौ प्रजा वर्धयतो देवान् सर्वान् सुतान् पितृन्। भवेयातां स्थितौ धर्मे श्रद्धेयौ सुतपस्विनौ॥
en: Both the priest and the king should have such qualities as arrest honour, and should observe the vows and penances. They would then succeed in supporting the subjects, the deities. the Pitris, and the children.

sa: न सकामा वयं ते च न चास्माभिर्न तैर्जितम्। न तैर्भुक्तेयमवनिर्न नार्यो गीतवादितम्॥
en: We have not gained our object, nor have they gained theirs. We have not defeated them, nor have they defeated us. The Dhartarashtras could not enjoy this Earth, nor could they enjoy women and music.

sa: कोशं दण्डं बलं मित्रं यदन्यदपि संचितम्। न कुर्वीतान्तरं राष्ट्र राजा परिगतः क्षुधा।॥
en: The king, even when reduced to straits, should never abandon his treasury, his machinery for punishing the wicked, his army, his friends and allies, and uther necessary institutions and the chiefs living in his kingdom.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वत्र बुद्धिः कथिता श्रेष्ठा ते भरतर्षभ। अनागता तथोत्पन्ना दीर्घसूत्रा विनाशिनी॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O foremost of Bharata's race, said that, that intelligence which provides for the future, as well as that which can meet present difficulties, is always superior, while idleness brings about destruction.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच यदि राजन् प्रसन्नस्त्वं मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्। भवतः शीलमिच्छामि प्राप्तुमेष वरो मम॥
en: The Brahmana said for. If, O king, you have been pleased with me and if you wish to do what is agreeable to me, I wish then to acquire your behaviour? This is the boon that I pray

sa: प्रगृह्य बाहून् क्रोशन्त्यः पुत्रान् भ्रातॄन् पितॄनपि। दर्शयन्तीव ता ह स्म युगान्ते लोकसंक्षयम्॥
en: Seizing each other's hands, they began to bewail aloud after their sons, brothers, and fathers. The presented a spectacle that takes place on the occasion of the universal destruction at the end of a cycle.

sa: भवत्या गूढमन्त्रत्वात् पीडितोऽस्मीत्युवाच ताम्॥ शशाप च महातेजाः सर्वलोकेषु योषितः। न गुह्यं धारयिष्यन्तीत्येवं दुःखसमन्वितः॥
en: 'For you having concealed your counsels, this great calamity has befallen me.' The highly energetic and the righteous king then, in sorrow, cursed all the women of the world, saying,-'Henceforth no woman shall succeed in keeping a secret."

sa: धर्मज्ञमानिनौ यौ त्वां वध्यमानमुपैक्षताम्। पाण्डवाश्चापि ते सर्वे किं वक्ष्यन्ति नराधिप॥ कथं दुर्योधनोऽस्माभिर्हत इत्यनपत्रपाः।
en: They consider themselves as moral, yet both of them were indifferent while you were killed! How will the other Pandavas, shameless as they are, O king, speak of the manner in which they have brought about your death?

sa: केन वै वर्धते राष्ट्र राजा केन विवर्धते। केन पौराश्च भृत्याश्च वर्धन्ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: By what means does a kingdom prosper and what are the means by which the king himself prospers? How also, O foremost of Bharata's race, do the citizens and the servants of the king prosper?

sa: आत्मवांश्च जितक्रोधः शास्त्रार्थकृतनिश्चयः। धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च सततं रतः॥
en: With soul purged off sins the king should be able to govern his anger and all his conclusions should be according to the scriptures. He should also always follow morality, worldly profit, pleasure and emancipation.

sa: ततो भूयो व्यगणयत् स्वबुद्ध्या मुनिसत्तमः॥ मोक्षे गार्हस्थ्यधर्मे वा किं नु श्रेयस्करं भवेत्।
en: Thereat that foremost of ascetics began to think with the help of his understanding, saying "Which of the two, viz., the religion of Moksha or that of a housc-holder, will be the better for me?

sa: प्रलापः सुमहान् कस्मात् क्रियते शोकमूच्छितैः। यदि कालः प्रमाणं ते कस्माद् धर्मोऽस्ति कर्तुषु॥
en: Why do people, deprived of their senses by grief, indulge in such lamentations? If Time, as you say, be the cause of all works, how can religious merit be acquired by persons performing religious acts?

sa: अनेन चास्य क्षुरनेमिनाद्य संछिन्धि मूर्धानमरेः प्रसा॥ मया विसृष्टेन सुदर्शनेन वज्रेण शक्रो नमुचेरिवारेः।
en: Concentrating all your might cut-off the head of your enemy with this Sudarshana of razor-like keen edge which I am giving to you, like Cakra who cut-off the head of Namuchi, his enemy with thunder.

sa: क्षेमदर्शी नृपसुतो यत्र क्षीणबलः पुरा। मुनि कालकवृक्षीयमाजगामेति नः श्रुतम्। तं पप्रच्छानुसंगृह्य कृच्छ्रामापदमास्थितः॥
en: We have heard that in days of yore, when prince Kshemadarshin had become weak in strength and fallen into great distress, he went to the sage Kalakavrikshiva and saluting him humbly, said him these words,

sa: कच्छपो दश वर्षाणि त्रीणि वर्षाणि शल्यकः। व्यालो भूत्वा च षण्मासांस्ततो जायति मानुषः॥
en: Living as a tortoise for ten years, he is born as a porcupine. After that he has to take birth as a snake, and living for six months in that form he regains human form.

sa: दमस्य तु फलं राजञ्छृणु त्वं विस्तरेण मे। दान्ताः सर्वत्र सुखिनो दान्ताः सर्वत्र निर्वृताः॥
en: Listen now to me, O king, as I tell you in detail what that fruits, are of self-control. The self-controlled are happy everywhere. The selfcontrolled always enjoy that happiness which results from the absence or subjugation of desire.

sa: मासं च रुधिरं चास्य मज्जा मेदश्च मे हितम्। परितोषकरो ह्येष मम मास्याग्रतो भव॥
en: His flesh and blood and marrow and fat will be of great good to me. This bird will be the means of pleasing me greatly. Do not, O king place yourself between him and me in this way.

sa: उमोवाच सावधं किन्नु वै कर्म निरवयं तथैव च। श्रेयः कुर्वन्नवाप्नोति मानवो देवसत्तम॥
en: Uma said What deeds, O foremost of the celestials, are faulty, and what deeds are faultless? What, indeed, are those deeds by doing which a man succeeds in acquiring what is for your highest good?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रुतं भगवतो वाक्यं धर्मयुक्तं परं हितम्॥ शरीरनिचयं ज्ञातुं बुद्धिस्तु मम जायते।
en: Yudhishthira said I have carefully heard the words spoken by your illustrious self, these words that are fraught with virtue, and that are highly beneficial, I wish now to know of the state of the body (after death.)

sa: नान्यदा गच्छते यस्तु ब्रह्मचर्ये च तत् स्मृतम्। अमृतं ब्राह्मणा गाव इत्येतत् त्रयमेकतः।
en: One, who never knows his wife at any other time except after the period of menses, is said lo observe the vow of Brahmacharya. Amrita (nectar), Brahmanas, and kine, these three are considered as equal.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु तत्त्वेन कौन्तेय दानं प्रति ममानघ। यथा दानं प्रदातव्यं सर्ववर्णेषु भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Listen, O son of Kunti, in full to me, O sinless one, as I describe the subject of gifts. Indeed, I shall tell you, Bharata, how gifts should be made to all the orders of men.

sa: तस्य शुक्रस्य विस्पन्दान् पांसून् संगृह्य भूमितः। प्रास्यत् पूषा कराभ्यां वै तस्मिन्नेव हुताशने॥
en: On account of the seed having fallen on the dust, the Sun took up that dust mixed with the particles of seed from the Earth with his hands and cast it into the sacrificial fire.

sa: वीणानां वल्लकीनां च नू पुराणां च सिञ्जितैः। हासैश्च हरिणाक्षीणां सुप्तः स प्रतिबोध्यते॥
en: He sleeps there in peace and is awakened by the musical laughter of those gazelleeyed maidens, the sweet notes of their Vinas, the soft strains of their lutes, and the sweet tinkle of their Nupuras.

sa: एष मोक्षविदां धर्मो वेदोक्तः सत्पथः सताम्। यो मार्गमनुयातीमं पदं तस्य च विद्यते॥
en: This is the Religion of persons conversant with Liberation, as declared in the Vedas. This is the righteous path that is trodden by this virtuous, He who follows in this path, leaves no vestige behind.

sa: गावः स्वर्गस्य सोपानं गावः स्वर्गेऽपि पूजिताः। गाव: कामदुहो देव्यो नान्यत् किंचित् परं स्मृतम्।।
en: Kine form the stairs leading to Heaven. Kine are worshipped in Heaven itself. Kine are goddesses that can give everything and grant every wish. There is nothing else in the world that is so high or so superior.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा द्वैपायनवचो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातॄन् सर्वान् समानाय्य काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥ अर्जुनं भीमसेनं च माद्रीपुत्रौ यमावपि। श्रुतं वो वचनं वीरा: सौहृदाद् यन्महात्मना॥ कुरूणां हितकामेन प्रोक्तं कृष्णेन धीमता। तपोवृद्धेन महता सुहृदां भूतिमिच्छता॥ गुरुणा धर्मशीलेन व्यासेनाद्भुतकर्मणा। भीष्मेण च महाप्राज्ञा गोविन्देन च धीमता॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard the words of the Island-born ascetic king Yudhishthira the just, summoned all his brothers, viz., Arjuna and Bhimasena and the twin sons of Madri, in proper time and then said to them, You heroes, you have heard the words which the highly intelligent and great Krishna has said from his friendship for and the desire of doing good to the Kurus! Indeed you have heard those words that have been uttered by that ascetic of profuse penances, that great sage desirous of conferring prosperity on his friends, that preceptor of righteous conduct, viz., Vyasa of wonderful feats! You have heard what Bhishma also said, and what Govinda too of great intelligence has uttered.

sa: नारद उवाच न त्वामविषये भद्रे नियोक्ष्यामि कथंचन। स्त्रीणां स्वभावमिच्छामि त्वत्तः श्रोतुं वरानने॥
en: Narada said O amiable one, I shall not certainly ask you for any task that is beyond your power. O you of beautiful face, I wish to hear from you of the disposition of women.

sa: तेन विश्वं कृतमेतद्धि राजन् स जीवयत्यात्मनैवात्मयोनिः। ततो देवासुरान् मानवांश्च लोकानृषीश्चापि पितॄन् प्रजाश्चा समासेन विधिवत्प्राणिलोकान् सर्वान् सदा भूतपतिः सिसृक्षुः॥ शुभाशुभं स्थावरं जङ्गमं च विष्वक्सेनात् सर्वमेतत् प्रतीहि। यद वर्तते यच्च भविष्यतीह सर्वं ह्येतत् केशव त्वं प्रतीहि॥ मृत्युश्चैव प्राणिनामन्तकाले साक्षात् कृष्ण: शाश्वतो धर्मवाहः। भूतं च यच्चेह न विद्म किंचिद् विष्वक्सेनात् सर्वमेतत् प्रतीहि॥
en: Forsooth, O king, it is this Krishna who has created this universe. He has originated from his own self; it is he who causes all things to exist through his own power. He it is who has created the celestials, the Asuras, the human beings, the worlds, the Rishis, the departed manes and all creatures. Desirous of creating, that Lord of all creatures duly created the entire universe of life. Know that good and evil, mobile and immobile, have all originated from this one who is Vishvaksena. Whatever exists, and whatever will come into being, all is Keshava. This Krishna is also the death which overtakes all creatures when their end comes. He is eternal and it is he who upholds the cause of Virtue Whatever existed in the past, and whatever we do not know, indeed, all that also is this Vishvakse

sa: वासुदेव उवाच सर्व जिह्यं मृत्युपदमार्जवं ब्रह्मणः पदम्। एतावान् ज्ञानविषयः किं प्रलापः करिष्यति॥
en: Vasudeva said All crookedness of heart brings on destruction, and all rectitude leads to Brahma. This and this only in the aim and object of all true wisdom, what can mental distraction do (to him).

sa: जात्यन्धैरिह तुल्यास्ते मृतैः पङ्गुभिरेव च। समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति गङ्गां पुण्यजलां शिवाम्॥
en: Those who, although physically able do not seek to see the sacred Ganga, are, forsooth, comparable persons suffering from congenital blindness or those who are dead or those who are benumbed through palsy or lameness.

sa: नारद उवाच येनायं सृज्यते जन्तुस्ततोऽन्यः पूर्वमेति तम्। प्राणद्वन्द्वं हि विज्ञेयं तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्च यत्॥
en: Narada said By whatever the creature is created, that first comes to him which is other. The vital airs are to be known as existing in pairs, viz., those which move transversely, upwards, and downwards.

sa: कृत्वा च दक्षिणाग्रान् वै दर्भान् स प्रयतः शुचिः। प्रददौ श्रीमतः पिण्डान् नामगोत्रमुदाहरन्।॥
en: With a pure body and mind and with rapt attention, Niini, having placed those blades of sacred grass in the way indicated, offered cakes of rice to his dead son, uttering his name and family.

sa: उमोवाच भगवन् संशयः पृष्टस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य यो धर्मः स्वे स्वे वर्णे गुणावहः॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, I wish to ask you another question about with I entertain great doubts. You should answer it and remove my doubts. What are the meritorious duties of the four castes.

sa: न रज्ज्वा न च दण्डेन न लोष्टैर्नायुधेन च। उद्वेजयति भूतानि श्लक्ष्णकर्मा दयापरः॥
en: He never afflicts any creature with either cords or clubs or brickbats or clods of hard earth or weapons of any sort. His deeds are never fierce or cruel, and he is full of mercy.

sa: असज्जन्त प्रजाः सर्वाः कामक्रोधवशं गताः। न च स्त्रीणां क्रियाः काश्चिदिति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः।।११
en: Persons of the male sex, yielding to the power of Lust and Anger, sought the companionship of women. Women have no especial acts laid down for them. This is the ordinance that was laid down.

sa: सुसंवृतं मन्त्रगृहं स्थलं चारुह्य मन्त्रयेः॥ अरण्ये निःशलाके वा न च रात्रौ कथंचन।
en: Entering a chamber or spot that is wellprotected (from intruders) you should hold your consultations. You may hold your consultation in a forest hat is divested of grass. You should never consult at night time.

sa: धनंजयगृहानेव ययौ कृष्णस्तु वीर्यवान्। तत्रार्चितो यथान्यायं सर्वकामरूपस्थितः॥ कृष्णः सुष्वाप मेधावी धनंजयसहायवान्। प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकी क्रियाम्॥ धर्मराजस्य भवनं जग्मतुः परमार्चितौ। यत्रास्ते स सहामात्यो धर्मराजो महाबलः॥
en: Krishna of great energy proceeded to the apartments of Dhananjaya, Adored duly and furnished with every object of comfort and enjoyment, Krishna of great intelligence passed the night in happy sleep with Dhananjaya as his companion. When the night passed away and morning came, the two heroes, finishing their morning rites and adoring their persons properly proceeded to the palace of king Yudhishthira the just. There Yudhishthira the just, of great might, sat with his ministers.

sa: निकृती हि नरो लोकान् पापान् गच्छत्यसंशयम्। विदुलस्येव तत् पुष्पं मोघं जनयितुः स्मृतम्॥
en: That man who acts deceitfully, has, forsooth, to go to the regions of grief and every kind of evil. The birth of such a person is of no avail like the flowers of the cane.

sa: ततः प्रधानमसृजत् प्रकृति स शरीरिणाम्। यया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं यां लोके परमां विदुः॥
en: Having first himself taken a body, he then created Pradhana. That Pradhana is the material cause of all embodied creatures, by whom is all this covered, and whom all came to know as the greatest.

sa: मुधा ज्ञानं मुधा वृत्तं मुधा सेवा मुधा श्रमः। एवं यो युक्तधर्मः स्यात् सोऽमुत्रात्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: He who is devoted to the duty of Yoga, considering knowledge to the vain conduct to be vain, service to be vain, and mode of life to be vain, attains to what is highest in the next world.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच श्रावितस्त्वं मया गुह्यं ज्ञापितश्च सनातनम्। धर्मं स्वरूपिणं पार्थ सर्वलोकांश्च शाश्वतान्॥
en: Vasudeva said I made you listen to truths that are considered as mysteries. I conferred on you eternal truths. Indeed, I described to you Religion in its true form and on all the eternal regions.

sa: दीक्षयस्व त्वमात्मानं त्वं हि नः परमो गुरुः। त्वयीष्टवति दाशार्ह विपाप्मा भविता ह्यहम्॥
en: Do you, therefore, cause yourself to undergo the rites of initiation. You are our highest preceptor and master. If you perform the sacrifice, O you of the Dasharha-race, I shall be purified from every sin.

sa: न तेषां भिद्यते वृत्तं यज्ञाः स्वाध्यायकर्म च। आचारः कारणं चैव धर्मश्चैकस्त्रयं पुनः॥
en: The conduct of those persons never goes wrong or meets with destruction, as also their sacrifices and Vedic study and rites. Indeed, these three, viz., good conduct, mental purity, and the Vedas together form virtue.

sa: एषा ते कथिता राजन् सावित्री ब्रह्म शाश्वती। विवक्षुरसि यच्चान्यत् तत् वे वक्ष्यामि भारत॥
en: In have thus, O king, told you of the Savitri Mantras which are at one with eternal Brahma. If you wish to question mc on any other subject, you may do so. I shall, O Bharata, answer you.

sa: व्यसनं भेदनं चैव शत्रूणां कारयेत् ततः। कर्षणं भीषणं चैव युद्धे चैव बलक्षयम्॥
en: He should next cause the enemy to be plunged into various calamities, and show dissension's among his allies. He should afflict the enemy and inspire terror in his heart, and, attacking him, weaken his forces.

sa: यो दरिद्रैरपि विधिः शक्यः प्राप्तुं सदा भवेत्। अर्थन्यूनैरवगुणैरेकात्मभिरसंहतैः॥ तुल्यो यज्ञफलैरेतैस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह।
en: Do you tell, us O grandfather, what the ordinances are about those acts that are fraught with merit equal to what belongs to Sacrifices and which, therefore, are capable of being performed by poor men.

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच दाता ब्राह्मणसत्कर्ता दीनार्तकृपणादिषु। भक्ष्यभोज्यानपानानां वाससां च प्रदायकः॥ प्रतिश्रयान् सभाः कूपान् प्रपाः पुष्करिणीस्तथा। नैत्यकानि च सर्वाणि किमिच्छकमतीव च।॥ आसनं शयनं यानं गृहं रत्नं धनं तथा। सस्यजातानि सर्वाणि गाः क्षेत्राण्यथ योषितः॥ सुप्रतीतमना नित्यं यः प्रयच्छति मानवः। एवंभूतो नरो देवि देवलोकेऽभिजायते॥
en: Maheshvara said He who has a liberal disposition, who honours Brahmanas and treats them with hospitality, who makes gifts of food and drink and clothes and other articles of enjoyment to the destitute; the blind and the distressed, who makes gifts of houses erects hall, digs wells, constructs shelters whence pure and cool water is distributed, excavates tanks makes arrangements for the free distributions of gifts every day, gives to all comers what each prays for, who makes gifts of seats and beds and vehicles, wealth, jewels and gems, houses, all kinds of corn, kine, fields and women, he who always makes these gifts with a cheerful heart, becomes a denizen, O goddess, of the celestial region.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स गौतमं पुरस्कृत्य सह पुत्रेण हस्तिना। दिवमाचक्रमे वज्री सद्भिः सह दुरासदम्॥
en: Bhishma said Having said these words, the holder of the thunderbolt, taking Gautama with him and placing him before, along with his son, viz., that elephant, went to Heaven, that is difficult of attainment by even the pious.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच गतोऽस्म्याङ्गिरसः पुत्रं देवाचार्यं बृहस्पतिम्। यज्ञार्थमृत्विजं द्रष्टुं स च मां नाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Marutta said Trying to find out a priest to officiate at my sacrifice, I went to that priest of the Immortals, Brihaspati, the son of Angirasa, but he did not choose to accept my offer.

sa: यदा रथं हेममणिप्रकाशं श्वेताश्वयुक्तं वानरकेतुमुचम्। द्रष्टा ममाप्यास्थितं केशवेन तदा तप्स्यत्यकृतात्मा स मन्दः॥
en: When also he sees my terrible car, guided by Keshava, shining with gold and precious stones, with white horses and with a banner having the figure of a monkey; then will that vicious-souled fool repent.

sa: येषां वैरी न स्वपिति षष्ठेऽपि विषये वसन्। तेषां मां मानिनीं भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
en: The son of a Suta has kicked me the honored spouse of those whose enemies can never sleep even if they reside in regions of anchorites (what to speak of their living in a country of their own).

sa: नित्यमज्ञातचर्या मे इति मन्येत ब्राह्मणः। ज्ञातीनां तु वसन् मध्ये तं विदुर्ब्राह्मणं बुधाः॥
en: That man is to be regarded as a Brahmana whose religious practices remain ever unknown even to the members of his family among whom he lives, wise men also know him to be a Brahmana.

sa: अस्मिन् पदे युध्यतां नो वधोऽपि श्लाध्य: पित्र्यं परराज्याद् विशिष्टम्। नाचक्षीथाः संजय राजमध्ये॥
en: Under these circumstances, to be killed white fighting would be praise-worthy for us. Ancestral wealth is better than the kingdom of another. Lay these ancient principles before the sons of Kurus amidst the assembled chiefs,

sa: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णश्च कुन्तिभोजो महामनाः॥ मातुलो भीमसेनस्य श्येनजिच्च महारथः। शङ्खः पुत्रो विराटस्य निधिस्त्वं च जनार्दन॥
en: And the great minded Kuntibhoja, the maternal uncle of Bhimasena, possessed of horses of the colors of the rainbow and the great car-warrior Shayenajit, Shankha the king of Virata and yourself like an ocean of resources, O Janardana.

sa: हिते प्रयतमानं मां शङ्केद् दुर्योधनो यदि। हृदयस्य च मे प्रीतिरानृण्यं च भविष्यति॥
en: If Duryodhana suspects me, striving for his good as I do, I shall at least be satisfied with myself in my heart and I shall be discharging the debt (I owe them as a friend).

sa: स्त्रियो राजकुले याश्च याश्चेमा मम वेश्मनि। प्रसक्तास्त्वां निरीक्षन्ते पुमांसं कं न मोहयेः॥
en: Charmed by your beauty even the females of the royal house hold and as well as those in my own seraglio are gazing at you. What male person is there whom you will not captivate?

sa: तन्मां दहति यत् कृष्णा सभायां कुरुसंनिधौ। धाष्ट्रैिः परिक्लिष्टा यथा न कुशलं तथा॥
en: The degree, to which this fact pains me, namely the dragging of Krishna to the Assembly-Hall in the presence of the Kurus and insulted by the sons of Dhritarashtra, is not equalled by death itself.

sa: समवेषं न कुर्वीत नोच्चैः संनिहितो वसेत्। न मन्त्रं बहुधा कुर्यादेवं राज्ञः प्रियो भवेत्॥
en: One should not dress like the king, should not burst out into a loud laughter in the presence of the king, nor should one divulge royal counsels; behaving in this way one may become favourite of the king.

sa: सारथ्यं तु त्वया कार्यमिति मे मानसं सदा। चिररात्रेप्सितं कामं तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: It has been my desire to have the office of the charioteer filled by you and it is fitting that you should fulfill this desire which has been felt by me for a long time.

sa: श्रीर्हता बाधते धर्मं धर्मो हन्ति हतः श्रियम्। श्रीर्हता पुरुषं हन्ति पुरुषस्याधनं वधः॥
en: Sense of shame being lost, desire of virtue is weakened; and the destruction of virtue causes the decline of prosperity. Prosperity being lost, the man meets with death; for poverty is death to a man.

sa: असम्प्राप्तानस्त्रपथं परस्य तदा द्रष्टा नश्यतो धार्तराष्ट्रान्। अकुर्वतः कर्म युद्धे समन्तात् तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When he sees the (other) sons of Dhritarashtra before even reaching within the range of the enemies' weapons fall down dead without even doing anything in the field; then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

sa: यत्र सा बृहती श्यामा सभायां रुदती तदा। अश्रौषीत् परुषा वाचस्तन्मे दुःखतरं महत्॥
en: As the weeping of the noble lady Krishna in the assembly at that time who was made to hear very harsh words; this was the source of a pain greater to me than all this.

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच पुत्र एको मम ब्रह्मंस्त्वं च साक्षादिहास्थितः। तयोर्विवदतोः प्रश्नं कथमस्मद्विधो वदेत्॥
en: Prahrada said I have got only one son; and you are a Brahmana present here in person. How can one situated as I am, answer the question, which is a matter of dispute between yourselves.

sa: यदि तावद् वने वासो यथोक्तश्चरितस्त्वया। तत् त्वं धर्मार्थवित् क्लिष्टः स मया योद्भुमिच्छसि।
en: If you had passed your exile in the same way as you said, and being distressed (for practising austerities) why do you conversant with Dharma and Artha as you are, wish to fight with me?

sa: तथा स भिन्नहृदयः समुत्सृज्य कपीश्वरम्॥ कुम्भकर्णो महेष्वासः प्रगृहीतशिलायुधः। अभिदुद्राव सौमित्रिमुद्यम्य महतीं शिलाम्॥
en: His heart being (thus) riven, he let go the monkey king. (And then) that mighty bowman, Kumbhakarna, taking a stone as his arrow, rushed at the son of Sumitra, aiming that huge stone at him.

sa: कृष्णाजिनानि परिधित्समानान् दुःशासनः कटुकान्यभ्यभाषत्। एते सर्वे षण्ढतिला विनष्टाः क्षयं गता नरकं दीर्घकालम्॥
en: Dushasana also spoke these harsh words when they were about to put on garments made of the skin of black deer. "All these eunuchs vanquished and ruined are going to hell for a long period."

sa: ततः पीताम्बरधरो जगत्स्रष्टा जनार्दनः। गते दुर्योधने कृष्णः किरीटिनमथाब्रवीत्। अयुध्यमानः कां बुद्धिमास्थायाहं वृतस्त्वया॥
en: Duryodhana having departed, the creator of the world, Janardana, with yellow robes on, said to the wearer of the crown-"Knowing that I shall not take any part in the battle, why have you chosen me?"

sa: कृष्णवर्मेव ज्वलितः समिद्धो यथा दहेत् कक्षमग्निर्निदाघे। एवं दग्धा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सेना युधिष्ठिरः क्रोधदीप्तोऽन्ववेक्ष्य॥
en: As blazing fire, raging in all directions, burns up and withers dry grass during summer, so will the army of the son of Dhritarashtra be withered by the mere glance of Yudhishthira fired by wrath.

sa: चिन्तयामास तस्यैव वधोपायं युधिष्ठिर। स तूष्र्णी चिन्तयन् वीरो देवराजः प्रतापवान्।॥ विनिश्चितमतिर्धीमान् वधे त्रिशिरसोऽभवत्।
en: O Yudhishthira, he thought of some means to slay him. And the chief among the gods who was valiant, famous as a gifted being of unfailing judgment and intelligent, fixed on a plan for slaying the three-headed one.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तामभिप्रेक्ष्य विशालनेत्रां जिघृक्षमाणः परिभर्सयन्तीम्। जग्राह तामुत्तरवस्त्रदेशे स कीचकस्तां सहसाऽऽक्षिपन्तीम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Wishing thus to take hold of her Kichaka, seeing that large-eyed lady reproaching him in this wise, seized her by the end of her upper garment while she was about to run away.

sa: यक्ष उवाच धन्यानामुत्तमं किंस्विद् धनानां स्यात् किमुत्तमम्। लाभानामुत्तमं किं स्यात् सुखानां स्यात् किमुत्तमम्।७३।
en: The Yaksha asked What is the best of all praise-worthy objects? What is the best of all sorts of wealth? What is the most important of all gains? And what is the best of all kinds of happiness?

sa: प्रवृत्तवाक् चित्रकथ ऊहवान् प्रतिभानवान्। आशु ग्रन्थस्य वक्ता च यः स पण्डित उच्यते॥
en: He is said to be a wise man who speaks boldly, can talk on diverse subjects, can argue well, has genius and who can explain the meaning of what is written in books at once.

sa: विराट उवाच परोक्षं नाभिजानामि विग्रहं युवयोरहम्। अर्थतत्त्वमविज्ञाय किं नु स्यात् कौशलं मम॥
en: Virata said I do not know anything of your quarrel that happened out of our light. How can there be any justice on that score unless I go through the true version of the case.

sa: गतिं त्रयाणां पिण्डानां शृणुष्वावहितो मम॥ अपो गच्छति यो ह्यत्र शशिनं ह्येष प्रीणयेत्।
en: Listen with attention, O Bharata, to me as I explain what the end is of the three rice balls. That rice ball which goes into water is considered as pleasing the deity of the Moon.

sa: तं वै प्रमृष्टं प्रसमीक्ष्य युद्धे चचाल सर्वं सचराचरं जगत्। स्तमुद्यतं प्रेक्ष्य महाहवेषुम्॥
en: Seeing that arrow taken up by Partha in battle, the entire universe trembled with its mobile and immobile creations. Beholding that arrow about to be discharged the Rishis cried aloud "Peace be to the universe.

sa: अतस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां धर्मं वेत्स्यसि वै परम्। स्वदेशे परदेशे वा न ते धर्मो विनक्षयति॥
en: Behaving thus, you will be able to learn the duties of all orders of men. This will help you in observing your own duties whether when you are in your country or when you go to other kingdoms.

sa: अग्निरुवाच बृहस्पते न पश्यामि देवराजमिह क्वचित्। आपः शेषाः सदा चापः प्रवेष्टुं नोत्सहाम्यहम्॥
en: The god of fire said O Brihaspati, nowhere, in this world do I see the king of the gods. The waters (alone) remain (to be searched). I have never been able to enter the waters.

sa: एवं त्वमपि राजेन्द्र राज्यं प्राप्स्यसि भारता वृत्रं हत्वा यथा प्राप्तः शक्रः कौरवनन्दन॥
en: O chief among kings, O son of Bharata, you too will get your kingdom in the same way as Shakra got his by slaying Vritra, O you who cause rejoicing among the race of Kurus.

sa: पुनरुक्तं च वक्ष्यामि त्वं राधेय निबोध तत्। मास्मै ते कुण्डले दद्या भिक्षिते वलापाणिना॥
en: O Radha's son, I am telling you again what I have already said. Pay attention to it. You will by no means give the ear-rings to the wielder of the thunderbolt when he will beg them (of you).

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं पिण्डेषु त्रिषु श गतिः॥ फलं वृत्तिं च मार्गं च यश्चैनं प्रतिपद्यते।
en: I wish to hear this, that is, what are the ends attained by the balls offered at Shraddhas when thus disposed of by being thrown into the waters, given to the wife, and thrown into the burning fire.

sa: व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धौ गर्जन्ताविव तोयदौ॥ जहषाते महाबाहू सिंहकेसरिणाविवा जगाविव सुसंरब्धौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ॥ ददृशाते महात्मानौ सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ। रोषात् प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठौ निरीक्षन्तौ परस्परम्॥ तौ समेतौ महात्मानौ गदाहस्तौ नरोत्तमौ।
en: Looking like two enraged tigers or like two roaring masses of clouds, they became glad like two manned lions. Like two angry or two blazing fires, those two great ones appeared like two mountains with tall summits. With lips swelling with rage and looking upon each other those two heroes, armed with maces, met each other. Both were elated with joy and each regarded the other as a worthy opponent.

sa: भूमेर्गन्धगुणान् वेत्ति रसं चाभ्यः शरीरवान्। ज्योतिषा चक्षुषा रूपं स्पर्श वेत्ति च वाहिना॥
en: Through the earth-element an embodied creature perceives the properties of scent. From the water-element he perceives taste. From the fire-element as represented by the eyes, he perceives forms, and from the wind-element he perceives touch.

sa: ततः सर्वायसीं शक्तिं चिक्षेपाधिरथिं प्रति॥ तां ज्वलन्तीमिवाकाशे शरैश्चिच्छेद सप्तभिः। सा छिन्ना भूमिमगमन्महेष्वासस्य सायकैः॥
en: He hurled in anger at the son of Adhiratha a dart made of iron. He too cut of that (dart) shining in the sky with seven arrows; sundered with shafts by that great bowman it reached the earth.

sa: तं शल्यः प्राह मा कर्ण गृहीथाः पार्थिवोत्तमम्। गृहीतमात्रो हत्वा त्वां मा करिष्यति भस्मसात्॥
en: King Shalya in the meantime made Karna alert by saying-"O Karna! Don't' touch king Yudhishthira at all nonetheless you should burn in the fire erupted due to anger within him. You touch may cause of death for you.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मरतः पार्थ पितॄन् देवांश्च तर्पय। श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे चैव व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: Devoted to the practices of the Kshatriya do you, O son of Pritha, please the departed manes and the celestials. You shall then acquire great benefits. Indeed let the fever of your heart be removed.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तं ते गोप्रदानं वै नाचिकेतमृषि प्रति। माहात्म्यमपि चैवोक्तमुद्देशेन गवां प्रभो॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have O grandfather, describe to me the topic of gifts of kine in speaking of the Rishi Nachiketa You have also, related O powerful one, the efficacy and preeminence of that act.

sa: अनाद्यं तत्परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः। एकस्तद् वेद भगवान् धाता नारायणः प्रभुः॥
en: Neither the gods nor the Rishis were able to grasp Brahma who is without beginning and who is the highest of the high. Only the divine creator of all things, viz., the powerful Narayana, had known of Brahma.

sa: तथैव कर्मणा कृत्स्नं महतस्तपसोऽपि च। तेजो मन्युं च विभ्रत्त्वं जातो रौद्रो महामते॥
en: You endued in energy and wrath also, O you of generous heart, have sprung from a portion of Rudra, through the merits of all your pious deeds and as a consequence of high ascetic austerities.

sa: या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर्या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः। योऽसौ प्राणान्तिको रोगस्तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम्॥३६
en: Those men, who can renounce this thirst, which can never be renounced by the wicked, which decays not with the decay of the body and which is a fatal disease, can be freed from misery.

sa: उष्टेषु यदि वा गोषु खरेष्वश्वेषु वा पुनः। वरिष्ठो भविता जन्तुः शून्यागारे शचीपते॥
en: O husband of Sachi, Vali may now have taken his birth among camels or bulls or asses or horses, and having become the foremost of his species may now be living in an empty room.

sa: यो ह्याजिजीविषेद् भैक्ष्यं कर्मणा नैव कस्यचित्। समारम्भान् बुभूषेत हतस्वस्तिरकिंचनः। सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातो न पुत्रपशुसंहितः॥
en: He that would lead the life of a mendicant, cannot, by any act of his, enjoy the good things of Earth. Shorn of prosperity and other resources, he can never acquire fame on Earth or sons and animals.

sa: कुले महति जातास्मि दिव्येन विधिना किला पाण्डवानां प्रिया भार्या स्नुषा पाण्डोर्महात्मनः॥
en: I was born in a great race and I came to the world in an extraordinary way. I am the beloved wife of the Pandavas and the daughterin-law of the illustrious Pandu.

sa: तस्य विष्णुर्महातेजाः पाणिना चेतनां हरत्। स पपात ततो भूमौ गिरिराज इवाहतः॥
en: Lomasha said: Thereupon the greatly powerful Vishnu deprived him (Naraka) of his senses by striking him with his hands. He (Naraka) the fell down on the ground dead, like a great mountain.

sa: स चाप्यग्न्याहितो विप्रः क्रिया यस्य न हीयते। श्रेयो ह्यनाहिताग्नित्वमग्निहोत्रं न निष्क्रियम्॥
en: That Brahmana is said to possess the sacred fire whose acts exist in full. It is better to at once leave off the sacred fire than to keep it, abstaining from acts.

sa: स त्वं भ्रातृनसम्बुद्ध्य मोहाद् यदुपसेवसे। धार्तराष्ट्रान् न तद्युक्तं त्वयि पुत्र विशेषतः॥
en: You, who are such, are now, without recognizing your brothers owing to ignorance (of the true story), serving the sons of Dhritarashtra; it is not proper and especially for you, my son.

sa: निर्यशस्कास्तथा दैत्याः कृत्स्नशो विलयं गताः। देवास्तु सागरांश्चैव सरितश्च सरांसि च॥ अभ्यगच्छन्धर्मशीला: पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। तपोभिः क्रतुभिर्दानैराशीर्वादैश्च पाण्डव॥ प्रजहुः सर्वपापानि श्रेयश्च प्रतिपेदिरे। एवमादानवन्तश्च निरादानाश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Covered with infamy the Daityas were soon destroyed. O son of Pandu, the celestials, however, who were all of virtuous character, going to the seas, rivers and lakes and other sacred places, cleansed themselves of all their sins by means of asceticism and sacrifices, by gifts and blessings; and O Pandava, they obtained great prosperity. Because they thus abandoned all evil deeds and practised all good deeds,

sa: राजोवाच गोप्रदानगुणान् सम्यक् पुनर्मे ब्रूहि भारत। न हि तृप्याम्यहं वीर शृण्वानोऽमृतमीदृशम्॥
en: The king said Do you, O Bharata, once more describe to me in full merits of giving away kine. Indeed, O hero, I have not been satiated with hearing your nectarlike words.

sa: येऽपि तत्रापिबन् क्षीरं घृतं दधि च मानवाः। ब्राह्मणाः सहराजन्याः सर्वे नरकमाविशन्॥
en: All those men also, Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, who drank milk or clarified butter or curds, in the palace of the king who had stolen the Brahmana's kine, had to fall into hell.

sa: दमयन्तीसकाशे त्वां कथयिष्यामि नैषध। यथा त्वदन्यं पुरुषं न सा मंस्यति कर्हिचित्॥
en: O prince of the Nishadhas, I will speak of you before Damayanti and in such a manner that she will never mind to have any other person (for her lord) but yourself."

sa: जानता हि नरेन्द्रेण ख्यापनार्थं परस्य वै। प्रकाशं चोदिता देवी प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्॥
en: That goddess-like lady, being thus addressed before all the ministers by the king, for the proclamation of his innocence to others, though he knew everything, replied to the lord of the earth.

sa: तं प्राप्तमपि नेयेष परावृत्तं महाद्वित्तं महाद्विपम्। सारोहं मृत्युसात्कर्तुं स्मरन् धर्म धनंजयः॥
en: Thus Dhananjaya, though he got an opportunity of slaying that mighty elephant and its rider from the right side, yet did not avail himself of it, recollecting the laws of fair combat.

sa: अद्य चाप्यस्य राष्ट्रस्य हतोत्साहस्य संजय। अवशेषं न पश्यामि ककुदे मृदिते सति॥
en: O Sanjaya, today, when the hump of this kingdom has been crushed, I see that nothing will be left of it, as it has lost all energy (by the death of Drona).

sa: तेन ते संधिरेवास्तु विश्वसास्मिन् यथा मयि। न राज्यमनमात्येन शक्यं शास्तुमपि त्र्यहम्॥
en: Let there be friendship between him and you. Do you place confidence in him as in myself. A king who has no capable minister cannot govern his kingdom even for three days.

sa: पराभवो द्वैतवने य आसीद् दुर्मन्त्रिते घोषयात्रागतानाम्। यत्र मन्दाञ्छत्रुवशं प्रयातानमोचयद् भीमसेनो जयश्च।।
en: The defeat that they met with in the forest named when ill advised they went there and when Bhimasena and Arjuna faced these dull headed ones who were imprisoned by the enemy.

sa: कर्म शूद्रे कृषिवैश्ये दण्डनीतिश्च राजनि। ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो मन्त्राः सत्यं चापि द्विजातिषु॥
en: Menial service is the duty of the Shudra; agriculture is that of the Vaishya; the science of punishment of the Kshatriya and Brahmacharya, penances, Mantras, and truth, belong to the Brahmana. or

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य संदेशो न हन्तव्या नृपा इति। तेन जीवसि राजंस्त्वमपराद्धोऽपि मे रणे।॥
en: The command I received from Yudhishthira was that kings who oppose me should not be killed. It is for this you live yet, O monarch, although you have offended me in battle.

sa: तस्यार्जुनो धनुः सूतमश्वान् केतुं च सायकैः। हत्वा सप्तभिरेकेन छत्रं चिच्छेद पत्रिणा॥
en: Arjuna, on the other hand, after having destroyed his (antagonist's) bow, charioteer, horses and the standard by means of seven sharp shafts, severed his (foe's) umbrella by means of another winged arrow.

sa: आरोहन् दमयंश्चैव क्रीडंश्च परिधावति। ततोऽस्य नाम चक्रुस्ते कण्वाश्रमनिवासिनः॥ अस्त्वयं सर्वदमनः सर्वं हि दमयत्यसौ। स सर्वदमनो नाम कुमारः समपद्यत॥ विक्रमेणौजसा चैव बलेन च समन्वितः।
en: He rode on some of these wild beasts; he seized some of them and sometimes he pursued some of them in playful mood. The dwellers of the hermitage of Kanva, (finding all this), gave him a name. (They said,) “As he subjugated all beasts, let him be called Sarvadamana". Thus the prince came to be called Sarvadamana, endued as he was with great strength, energy and powers.

sa: यत्नेन महता वीरौ वारयामासतुस्ततः॥ निवार्य परमेष्वासौ कोपसंरक्तलोचनौ। युयुत्सूनपरान् संख्ये प्रतीयुः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: With great difficulty restrained those two heroes. Thus restraining those two mighty bowmen, whose eyes were red in rage, the foremost of the Kshatriyas advanced desirous of meeting the foe in battle.

sa: न ज्ञातिभ्यो दया यस्य शुक्लदेहोऽविकल्मषः। हिंसा सा तपसस्तस्य नानाशित्वं तपः स्मृतम्॥
en: He who has no feeling of kindness for his relatives even if his body be pure cannot be free from sin. That hard-heartedness of his mind is his great enemy to asceticism.

sa: अधिभूतं तथा गन्धो वायुस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। एषु पञ्चसु भूतेषु त्रिषु यश्च विधिः स्मृतः॥
en: As comected with objects it is scent; and the presiding deity there is the wind. Thus has the manner been described of how the five entities are divided into sets of three.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु युद्धे तुमुले प्रवृत्ते पार्थ विकर्णोऽतिरथं रथेन। विपाठवर्षेण कुरुप्रवीरो भीमेन भीमानुजमससाद॥
en: When the battle grew dreadful, Vikarana, a leading Kuru hero, getting upon his own chariot, moved towards that mighty carwarrior, Partha, the younger brother of Bhima with a dreadful downpour of shafts.

sa: यत्सेनाः समकम्पन्त यद्वीरानस्पृशद् भयम्। के तत्र नाजहुर्दोणं के क्षुद्राः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: In that battle, in which soldiers trembled and even heroes were inspired with fear, who were they that did not forsake Drona and who were those mean fellows that fled out terror?

sa: युद्धे संकर्षणसमो बलेनाभ्यधिको भुवि। गदाप्रहारं भीमो मे न जातु विषहेद् युधि।॥
en: In a fight I am Sankarshana's equal and in strength there is none my equal in the world; Bhima will not be able to bear the blows of my mace in battle.

sa: भवन्तः स्वार्थलोभेन केवलं भक्षणे रताः। अनुबन्धे त्रयो दोषास्तान् न पश्यन्ति मोहिताः॥
en: Actuated by the desire of getting what is agreeable, you are only busy with filling your stomachs. Overcome by folly, you are blind to the three faults which are in the end.

sa: समुद्रं यास्यति श्रीमांस्त्यक्त्वा देहं हलायुधः। जरा कृष्णं महात्मानं शयानं भुवि भेत्स्यति॥
en: The blessed hero armed with the plough will enter the ocean renouncing his body, while a hunter of the name of Jara will pierce the great Krishna while lying on the ground.'

sa: नरेशेऽयं सततं देही नृपते पुण्यपापयोः। तत एव समुत्थेन तमसा रुध्यतेऽपि च॥
en: Individual with body, O king, is not the author of his merits and demerits. On the other hand, he becomes covered with the Darkness that is begotten by his merits and demerits.

sa: देवापिश्च कथं ब्रह्मन् विश्वामित्रश्च सत्तम। तन्ममाचक्ष्व भगवन् परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: How also did Devapi, O Brahmana and how did Vishvamitra, O best of men, become Brahmanas. Tell me all this, O worshipful One! Great is my curiosity to hear of all this."

sa: कृष्ण एव हि लोकानामुत्पत्तिरपि चाप्ययः। कृष्णस्य हि कृते विश्वमिदं भूतं चराचरम्॥
en: Krishna is the origin of the universe, and he is that in which the universe is to dissolve. This universe of mobile and immobile creatures has sprung into existence from Krishna alone.

sa: स कुम्भकर्णो हृतकर्णनासो विदारितस्तेन रदैनखैश्च। रोषाभिभूतः क्षतजार्द्रगावः सुग्रीवमाविध्य पिपेष भूमौ ॥
en: Kumbhakarņa losing his ears and nose and having his sides split with nails and teeth grew angry, and becoming all covered over with blood, threw Sugrīva to the ground and pressed him.

sa: मृगरूपधरं हत्वा मामेवं काममोहितम्। अस्य तु त्वं फलं मूढ प्राप्स्यसीदृशमेव हि॥
en: As you have killed me in the form of a deer when I was full of desire, so you, O foolish man, will certainly meet with the fate that has befallen me.

sa: गतिं हि सर्वभूतानामगत्वा क्व गमिष्यति। यो धावता न हातव्यस्तिष्ठन्नपि न हीयते॥
en: Brahma in the form of Time is the refuge of all creatures. Where can you go transcending that Time? Time or Brahma, indeed, cannot be shunned by running nor by standing still.

sa: व्यस्ते काले पुनश्चैति न चैति बहुशो द्विजः। सुदुर्लभमपि ह्यन्नं दीयतामिति सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: At several times the Brahmana came after the appointed time or did never come at all and (on many occasions) asked for food when it could only be procured with utmost difficulty.

sa: तस्य चानदतो द्रोणः शिरः कायात् सकुण्डलम्। क्षुरेणापाहरत् तूर्णं ततो मत्स्याः प्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Then Drona, with a shaft like a razor speedily severed from his trunk, the head graced with ear-rings, of Shatanika thus roaring at him. Thereat all the Matsyas took to their heels.

sa: श्येन उवाच उशीनर कपोते ते यदि स्नेहो नराधिप। आत्मनो मांसमुत्कृत्य कपोततुलयाधृतम्॥
en: The Hawk said : O Ushinara, O ruler of men, if you have so much affection for the pigeon, then cut a portion of your flesh and weigh it against this pigeon.

sa: अद्य कुन्त्याः परिक्लेशं वनवासं च कृत्स्नशः। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं प्रणेष्यामि हते त्वयि॥
en: Slaying you, I will this day soothe the sorrows of Kunti and also those of Draupadi, today will I avenge the woes that we did suffer during our exile in the woods.

sa: छिद्रं हि मृगयन्त्येते विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसाः। विधिहीनस्य यक्षस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति ॥
en: For flaws in this foremost of sacrifices are watched by learned Brahma-Rākşasas. And should it come to be celebrated in violation of the ordinance, ihe performer thereof shall meet with instant destruction.

sa: अकृतव्रण उवाच स वेदाध्ययने युक्तो जमदग्निर्महातपाः। तपस्तेपे ततो देवान् नियमाद् वशमानयत्॥
en: Akritavrana said: The greatly ascetic Jamadagni devoted himself to the study of the Vedas. Thereupon he performed great austerities. Pursuing a methodical course of study, he got a mastery over the Vedas.

sa: भीष्म उवाच र्नानाविधैर्बहुभिः कौरवेन्द्र। सहस्राक्षो देवराट् सम्प्रहृष्टः समीक्ष्य तं कोपनं विप्रमुख्यम्॥
en: Bhishma said After the Rishis and the royal sages had taken various oaths, O Kuru king, the thousand eye chief of the celestials, filled with joy, looked at the angry Rishi Agastya.

sa: ततः शतपथं कृत्स्नं सरहस्यं ससंग्रहम्। चक्रे सपरिशेषं च हर्षेण परमेण ह॥
en: Thereupon the entire Satapatha Brahmanas, with all their mysteries and with all their abstracts as also their appendices, appeared of themselves before my minds-eye, at which I became filled with great joy.

sa: अश्वं च तं परामृश्य विषयान्ते विषोपमाः। न भयं चक्रिरे पार्थाद् भीमसेनादनन्तरात्॥
en: Those warriors who were as terrible as dreadful poison, finding the horse within their dominion, seized it without being filled with any fear of Partha who was the younger brother of Bhimasena.

sa: उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात् परं बलम्। सोत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किंचिदपि दुर्लभम्॥
en: O worshipful one mighty is the course of energy. And than this there is no greater powerful on earth. And there is nothing unattainable in this world to one gifted with energy.

sa: तस्य शापान शक्तोऽस्मि पदाद् विचलितुं पदम् उपदेक्ष्यामि ते श्रेयस्त्रातुमर्हति मां भवान्॥
en: It is owing to his curse that I am unable to move even a step-father. It behoves you, therefore, to release me; and then I will instruct you as regards your welfare.

sa: न पूजयेत् त्वां को न्वद्य यत् त्रयोतशवार्षिकम्। अमर्षं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा धर्ममेवाभिकाङ्क्षसे॥
en: What person is there, who will not applaud you, you who, having forgotten the animosity fanned and kept alive for the last thirteen years, are solicitous for observing the precepts of morality?

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महाराज धार्तराष्ट्रः समन्ततः॥ न तु तं ममृषे भीमः सिंहनादं तरस्विनाम्।
en: Then the Dhartarashtras began to rent the air from all sides with their loud out-crics, but, O king, Bhima could not brook the lion-like roars of the enemy, all of great intrepidity.

sa: अथवा नश्यति प्रज्ञा प्राज्ञस्यापि सतस्तव। पचत्येनं तथा कालो भूतानां प्रभवो ह्ययम्॥
en: Or did your wisdom, wise and good as you were, come to naught? For God, who is the origin of all beings, make (every one) reap the fruit of his own acts.

sa: स त्वं मानुषमात्रेण रामेण युधि निर्जितः। न व्यपत्रपसे राजन्किमिदं राक्षसेश्वर ॥
en: Then (how) have you been overpowered in battle by Rāma who is a mere man? Why is it that you are not ashamed of it, О king, O lord of the Raksasas?

sa: निदर्शयित्वात्मबलं समुद्यतं कुरुष्व सर्वायुधसायकव्ययम्। न लक्ष्मणस्यैत्य हि बाणगोचरं त्वमद्य जीवन्सबलो गमिष्यसि॥
en: Displaying you own prowess, do you spend all your weapons and all your shafts. But coming within the ken of Laksmana's arrows, your will not today go hence, living with your forces.

sa: शङ्काहतात्मा दध्यौ स कपीन्द्रं तेजसा वृतम्। किमेष भगवान् नन्दी भवेत् साक्षादिहागतः॥ येन शप्तोऽस्मि कैलासे मया प्रहसिते पुरे। सोऽयं वानरमूर्तिः स्यात्किंस्विद् बाणोऽपि वासुरः॥
en: And gazing at that foremost of monkeys girt with power, and with his soul exercised with apprehension, he (thought), “Is this the worshipful Nandi, come hither in person, by whom I, on my jeering at him, had formerly been cursed in Kailāsa? (Rāvaņa had formerly laughed at Nandi for his monkey-face) Or is this one wearing the shape of a monkey Vāli's son, Bāņa?"

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि तव धर्मज्ञ तपसानेन सुव्रत। मया चैतव्रतं चीर्णं त्वया चैव धनाधिप॥
en: O righteous one, you of fair vows, I am wellpleased with this asceticism of your. I also had observed this vow; and you also, O lord of riches, have done the same.

sa: मिदं तु नूनं हृदयं स्थिरं मे। विदीर्यते यन्न सहस्रधाद्य वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य॥
en: Forsooth, my mind, divested of happiness and full of misery, is firin or else why is it not broken in sunder like to the summit of a hill clapped by a thunderbolt.

sa: गजानां दशसाहस्रं रथानामयुतं तथा। हयानामयुते द्वे च साग्रां कोटिं च रक्षसाम्॥
en: There are ten thousand elephants, an Ayuta cars, two of horses, and abouta koti of Raksasas, powerful and strong, and equipped with arms in conflict.* *These are, remarks the commentator, the leader.

sa: तं राजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनं वनौकसस्ते सहसा बहिः स्थिताः। दृष्ट्वाप्रमेयं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पं वितत्रसुस्ते सह यूथपालैः॥
en: Suddenly seeing that slayer of foes of immeasurable prowess, resembling a mountainsummit, walking along the highways, the woodrangers stationed outside (the monkey-camp), along with the leaders of bands, were seized with affright.

sa: स तस्य शृङ्ग सनगं सनागं सकाञ्चनं धातुसहस्त्रजुष्टम्। विकीर्णकूटं ज्वलिताग्रसार्नु प्रगृह्य वेगात्सहसोन्ममाथ॥
en: And (anon) on a sudden, he violently rooted up its summit with trees and elephants and gold, and furnished with thousand varieties of ore, having its tops torn and its slopes aflame.

sa: ततस्तु रक्षोऽधिपतिर्महात्मा हनूमताक्षे निहते कुमारे। मनः समाधाय स देवकल्पं समादिदेशेन्द्रजितं सरोषः॥
en: On prince Akşa having been slain by Hanumān, the magnanimous monarch of the Rākṣasas, wrought up by wrath, repressing his feelings, ordered Indrajit resembling a celestial, (to take the against the foe.)

sa: सोऽहं सुराणामपि दर्पहन्ता दैत्योत्तमानामपि शोककर्ता। कथं नरेन्द्रात्मजरयोर्न शक्तो मनुष्ययोः प्राकृतयोः सुवीर्यः॥
en: Am I not, who have shattered the pride of the celestials, afflicted the leading Daityas, and am gifted with excellent prowess, capable of discomfiting these two princess-very ordinary mortals as they are?

sa: विरूपरूपा विकृता विवर्चसो महानना दीर्घविरूपदर्शनाः। समीक्ष्य ता राक्षसराजयोषितो भयाद् विनष्टा जनकेश्वरात्मजा॥
en: Seeing the wives of the Rākṣasa inonarch, of frightful forms, monstrous; of lurid hue; having huge faces; with large horrid eyes, the daughter of Janaka has given up the ghost from fright.

sa: मम चेदं मतं तात धर्मोऽयमिति राघव। धर्ममूलं त्वया छिन्नं राज्यमुत्सृजता तदा॥
en: This, sire, is my opinion, this, O Raghava, is virtue. But you, having then renounced the kingdom, have laid the axe at the root* of righteousness. **Root, remarks, Rāmānuja, 'which is interest!'

sa: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः। नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः॥
en: Salutation and salutation to him that bring victory, and the joy that spring up from victory; and to him of yellow steeds. Salutation, salutation, O thousand-rayed one! Salutation and salutation to Aditya.

sa: सैन्यैः परिवृतो गच्छ शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः। वानरा हि महात्मानः शूराः सुव्यवसायिनः॥ एकाकिनं प्रमत्तं वा नयेयुदर्शनैः क्षयम्। तस्मात्परमदुर्धर्षः सैन्यैः परिवृतो व्रज॥ रक्षसामहितं सर्वं शत्रुपक्षं निषूदय॥
en: Go you surrounded by the forces bearing darts and maces in their hands. The monkeys are highsouled, heroic and well-skilled in battle; and if they find you alone or unwary, they may slay you with their teeth, Therefore do you exceedingly irresistible, go, environed by the forces; and destroy the entire party of the foes, who are bent upon doing harm to the Rākşasa.

sa: तत्किमेवं परिक्लिश्य लोकं मोहनिराकृतम्। जित एव त्वया सौम्य मर्त्यलोको न संशयः॥
en: What then is the use of affecting a race that is brought down ever by its own infatuation. O placid one, this world is verily conquered by you, there is no doubt.

sa: स बद्धस्तेन वल्केन विमुक्तोऽस्त्रेण वीर्यवान्। अस्त्रबन्धः स चान्यं हि न बन्धमनुवर्तते॥
en: Being bound with bark, that powerful (monkey) got himself freed from the binding of the weapon, for the binding force of a Brahma weapon becomes null when there is any other binding.

sa: तेन चक्रेण मारीचो विष्णुनेव रणे हतः। पतितो भूतले शैलात्क्षीणपुण्य इव ग्रहः॥
en: And wounded in the conflict (by Sañyodhakanţaka) with his discus, as if by Vişnu himself, Márica toppled down to the ground from the mountain, like to a planet whose merit has waned.

sa: अग्रगं धार्तराष्ट्राणां सर्वेषां शर्म वर्म च। रक्षितं वृषसेन सुषेणेन च धन्विना॥
en: Who was like a deadly serpent in battle, an adept in all weapons, the leader of all the sons of Dhritarashtra, may the very warder of their armour and coats of mail;

sa: अथाधित्यं धनुः कृत्वा शर्वः संधाय तं शरम्॥ युक्त्वा पाशुपतास्त्रेण त्रिपुरं समचिन्तयत्।
en: Then having filled his bow with the string and also having aimed that arrow and again having united his Pasupata weapon with that shaft, Hare reflected for a while that triple city.

sa: परवाच्येषु निपणः सर्वो भवति सर्वदा। आत्मवाच्यं न जानीते जानन्नपि च मुह्यति॥
en: There is in every country and every moment men who are experts in speaking of the faults of others. There is none who knows his own faults and knowing them becomes ashamed.

sa: कृषिश्च पाशुपाल्यं च दिशां दानं च धर्मतः। ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां शूद्रा विहिताः परिचारकाः॥
en: According to the Dharma-Shastras the occupations of the Vaisyas are agriculture, the rearing of cattle and gift; whereas the Sudras are ordained to be the servants of the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaisyas.

sa: संजय उवाच कुन्तयो युधि विक्रान्ता महासत्त्वा महाबलाः। सानुबन्धाः सहामात्या गाङ्गेयेन निपातिताः॥
en: Sanjaya said All the descendants of Kunti, exerting themselves with prowess in battle and possessed of great spirit and strength, was slain by Bhishma in battle with all their kinsmen and counselors.

sa: तत: सुपुढेन सुयन्त्रितेन सुसंशिताग्रेण शरेण शूरः। आकर्णमुक्तेन समाहितेन युधामन्युस्तस्य शिरो जहार॥
en: Then that choicest of warriors Yudhamanyu, drawing his bow to the full extent, sent an arrow, from it, with beautiful wings and of very keen edge and that struck off his head.

sa: आत्तशस्त्रस्य हि रणे वृष्णिवीरं जिघांसतः। यदहं बाहुमच्छत्सं न स धर्मो विगर्हितः॥
en: That I have lopped off your arm while you, armed to the teeth, were on the point of slaying the unarmed Satyaki, is not at all against the rules of fair combat.

sa: एतौ रणे समासाद्य समाश्वस्तः सुयोधनः। यत्र वध्यो भवेद् द्रोणः सूतपुत्रश्च सानुगः॥
en: Getting these two for his supporter in battle, Suyodhana has become confident of his success. Indeed it was Drona or the son of Suta, with his followers who deserved to be slain.

sa: सूतं चैकेन बाणेन रथनीडादपातयत्। द्वाभ्यां ध्वजं च च्छत्रं च च्छित्वा भूमावपातयत्॥
en: He then felled the former's charioteer from his niche of the car, with a single arrow. Cutting off his standard and umbrella with another two arrows, he felled them on the ground.

sa: त्वयि कर्णे कृपि द्रोणे मद्रराजेऽथ सौबले। महत् कार्यं समासक्तं प्रसीद द्विजसत्तम॥
en: To you and Karna and Kripa and Drona and the king of Madra and to the son of Subala, a heavy task is entrusted. O best of the twiceborn ones, be gratified.

sa: एते प्रशमने योगा महास्रस्य परंतप। सर्वथा पीडितो हि स्यादवध्यान् पीडयन् रणे॥
en: O afflicter of your foes, these are the occasions when this mighty weapon, should not be used. He that wants to afflict the unslayable by this weapon himself becomes afflicted by it.

sa: एतेन हि महाबाहो रक्षितव्यः स पार्थिवः। तमेष कथमुत्सृज्य मम कृष्ण पदानुगः॥
en: O mighty-armed one, it should have been this one's first duty to protect the king in battle. O Krishna, wherefore has then this one : abandoning him has followed in my wake?

sa: यस्यार्थे शस्त्रमादाय यमपेक्ष्य च जीवसि। च साद्य पतितः शेते पृष्ठे नावेदितस्तव॥
en: He for whose sake you have taken up arms and for whom you live, he, deprived of life, today lies on the field of battle, unknown to you and behind your back.

sa: तान् हयान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा द्विजाग्र्येण स पार्षतः। नामृष्यत युधां श्रेष्ठो याज्ञसेनिर्महारथः॥
en: Beholding those horses slain by that foremost of regenerate ones, that son of Prisata, that foremost of all warriors, born in virtue of a sacrifice, that mighty car-warrior, did not tolerate it.

sa: अजस्रमपतन् बाणा भीमसेनस्थं प्रति। ते व्योम्नि रुक्मविकृता व्यकाशन्त सहस्रशः॥ शलभानामिव वाताः शराः कर्णसमीरिताः। चापादाधिरथेर्बाणा: प्रपतन्तश्चकाशिरे॥ एको दीर्घ इवात्यर्थमाकाशे संस्थितः शरः। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिश्छादयन्निव तोयदः॥
en: Coursed in continuous lines towards the chariot of Bhima; those gold-decked arrows hurled by Karna, while ranging through the skies in large numbers, looked beautiful like continuous fights of locusts. The shaAs shot from the bow of the son of Adhiratha, as they flew through the heavens, appeared like one long arrows poised in the sky. Like a cloud covering the mountain breast with torrents of rain.

sa: चैत तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान्।॥ अन्यदस्मै वरं दद्यां श्वेतान् पञ्चशतान् हयान्। हेमभाण्डपरिछन्नान् सुमृष्टमणिभूषणान्॥
en: If the person, who will find out Arjuna for me, be not satisfied with it i shall give him a more valuable present, namely five hundred horses-with gold trappings and jewelled ornaments.

sa: विद्राव्य तु ततः सैन्यं पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः। यथा मृगगणान् सिंहः सैन्धवार्थे व्यलोडयत्॥
en: Then for getting at the ruler of the Sindhus, that son of Pandu, that afflicter of foes, routing your army, began to agitate it like a lion agitating a herd of deer.

sa: परिश्रान्ता हयाश्चास्य हययन्ता च माधव। न च भूरिश्रवाः श्रान्तः ससहायश्च केशव॥
en: His horses are tired and O Madhava his driver is worn out with fatigue. On the other hand, O Keshava, Bhurisrava is not at all fatigued and moreover he is well supported.

sa: परिचिन्त्य तु पश्यामि चक्रायुधमरिंदमम्। न सोऽस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु यो जयेत जनार्दनम्॥
en: Upon mature thought, I see that there is no person in the three worlds who is able to defeat that subduer of foe viz., Janaraddana, that hero bearing the discus in hand.

sa: इषुश्चाप्यभवद् विष्णुर्व्वलनः सोम एव च। अग्नीषोमौ जगत् कृत्स्नं वैष्णवं चोच्यते जगत्॥
en: Vishnu, Agni (the god of fire) and Soma formed the shaft of that bow. The entire was universe of nothing but Agni and Soma. The universe is also to consist of Vishnu.

sa: व्यंसिता चाप्युपायेन शक्रदत्ता मयानघ। ये हि धर्मस्य लोप्तारो वध्यास्ते मम पाण्डव॥
en: O sinless one, through our tactics the Sakti given to him by Shakra has been also rendered useless. O son of Pandu, those who destroy righteousness are all slayable by me. was

sa: संजय उवाच तथेति राजन् पुत्रस्ते सह कर्णेन भारत। अब्रबीन्मद्रराजस्य मतं भरतसत्तम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, O descendant of Bharata, O best of the Bharata race, your son, accompanied by Karna, replied to the son of the king of the Madras, saying-so be it.

sa: परान् सृजसि यद् वित्तं किंचित्त्वं बहु मूढवत्। अपात्रदाने ये दोषास्तान् मोहान्नावबुध्यसे॥
en: You are giving away your riches as if they are nothing like a highly ignorant man. You do not out of ignorance perceive the demerit attached to gifts made to unworthy persons.

sa: अवासृजद् रथे तां तु बिभेद गदया गदाम्। ततो भीमः पुनर्गुर्वी चिक्षेपाधिरथेर्गदाम्॥
en: Hurled it at Bhima's car. But the latter broke it down with a mace of his own. Thereafter once more Bhima threw with force a heavy mace at the son of Adhiratha.

sa: युध्यमानस्य च शिरः पश्यतां सुहृदा हृतम्। त्वया पुरुषशार्दूल सिंहेनेव यथा रुरोः॥
en: How did you cut-off his head, O most mighty one, as a tiger pieces off the head of a Ruru deer, while he was fighting, even in presence of all his allies?

sa: आसुरीव पुरा तांस्त्वमद्य नरव्याघ्र हत्वा पञ्च महारथान्॥ हतामित्रः प्रयच्छोर्वी राज्ञे सद्वीपपत्तनाम्।
en: O mightiest of men, by killing those five eminent charioteers today may you get rid of all foes and bestow this earth with all its islands, cities and seas to King Yudhishthira.

sa: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः। ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा वृषाङ्कं शरणं ययुः॥
en: Hearing this speech of his, all the celestials, under the leadership of Shakra, placing Brahman at their front, went to scek shelter of that god, who had a bull for his symbol.

sa: जयं ते प्रतिदास्यामि वासवस्येव पावकिः। प्रियं तव मया कार्यमिति जीवामि पार्थिव॥
en: I will secure to you victory as the son of Pavaka (i.e., Kartikeya) did to Vasava himself. In this battle which is now going on, I will do good offices to you.

sa: स मत्त इव मातङ्गः संक्रुद्धः पाण्डुनन्दनः। प्रविवेश जगानीकं मकरः सागर यथा॥
en: The wrathful son of Pandu, who looked like an unruly elephant, himself forced his way with the elephant division (of his enemies) as a Makara takes him sweeping dive in the sea.

sa: यावत् तेषां भयं पश्चात् तावदेषां पुरःसरम्। तद् गरीयस्तरं मन्ये यत्र कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: We have as much cause of apprehension behind those three as we have before them. But to my mind the cause of apprehension is greater there where both Krishna and Dhananjaya are.

sa: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाराज व्येतु ते भीर्धनंजये। यत्र वीरौ महेष्वासौ कृष्णौ सत्यपराक्रमौ॥
en: Knowing this, 0 king, let your apprehension on Dhananjaya's account be discarded, O mighty-monarch. Where the two heroic Krishnas, both fierce bowmen and both of prowess incapable of being baffled are present.

sa: शोकस्यान्तं न पश्यामि पारं जलनिधेरिव। चिन्ता मे वर्धतेऽतीव मुमूर्षा चापि जायते॥
en: I do not find the end of my so 'w like that of the overflowed ocean. My anxieties are growing more acute; and the desire for death has been growing in me.

sa: प्रतिज्ञेयं मया वृत्ता निहन्तव्यास्तु संयुगे। विकर्ण तेनासि हतः प्रतिज्ञा रक्षिता मया।॥
en: Bhima then said-"I vowed saying, You shall all be slain by me. O Vikarna, for this vow it is that you have been slain. And thus have I kept my bow inviolate.

sa: अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यं यत् पथ्यं तव पाण्डव॥ मावमंस्था महाबाहो कर्णमाहवशोभिनम्।
en: However, O son of Pandu, I shall tell you words that would conduce to your well-being. O strong-armed one, do not think lightly of Karna, who is a glory of the field.

sa: समार्गणगुणं चापं छित्वा तस्य महानसिः। निपपात ततो भूमौ च्युतः सर्प इवाम्बरात्॥
en: Thus having severed his (Dusasana's) bow along with its string and arrow, then that fearful sword fell down upon the earth, even as a snake falls down from heaven upon the ground.

sa: ततोऽधावन्त कौरव्या जिघृक्षन्तो युधिष्ठिरम्। दुष्टभावान् पाराज्ज्ञात्वा समवेता महारथाः॥ आजग्मुस्तं परीप्सन्त:कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: Then the Kuru soldiers rushed against Yudhishthira for seized him. Then apprised of the evil intention of the enemies the great carwarriors came there in a body for rescuing Kunti's son Yudhishthira.

sa: तथा शल्यसमो नास्ति हयज्ञाने हि कश्चन। सोऽयमभ्यधिकः कृष्णाद् भविष्यति रथो मम॥
en: Even as there exists not a single bowman, who is peer in respect to the management of arms, so there is no one, who resembles Shalya as to the knowledge of horses.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं वेश्मसु गुप्तेषु स्वास्तीर्णशयनोचिता। भूमौ निपतिता शेते सुखार्दा वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Yudhishthira said: How can, this beautiful lady accustomed to a life of case (and accustomed) to live in the private rooms and on beds spread over with sheets, sleep on the ground?

sa: सुतप्तं वस्तपो विप्राः प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना॥ यूयं जिज्ञासवो भक्ताः कथं द्रक्ष्यथ तं विभुम्।
en: The voice said You Brahmanas, you have performed well these penances with cheerful souls! Devoted to Narayana, you try to know how you may succeed in seeing that god of great power.

sa: प्रथममपि पलायिते त्वयि प्रियकलहा धृतराष्ट्रसूनवः। स्मरसि ननु यदा प्रमोचिताः खचरगणानवजित्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: Do you remember the occasion when you yourself were the first to take to your heels and the Pandavas, having defeated the Gandharvas headed by Chitraratha, liberated the quarrelsome sons of Dhritarashtra?

sa: एवं सुतपसा चैव हव्यकव्यैस्तथैव च॥ देवोऽस्माभिर्न दृष्टः स कथं त्वं द्रष्टुमर्हसि।
en: When with the help of even such austere penances of offerings devoutly given in sacrifices, we could not see the great Deity, how, indeed, can you except to see Him so easily?

sa: अरक्ष्यमाणं हि वृको हन्यात् सिंहं महाहवे। मा वृकेणेव गांगेयं घातयेम शिखण्डिना॥
en: If left unprotected, in a great forest, even a wolf can slay a lion. We should not allow Ganga's son to be slain by Shikhandi like a lion slain by a wolf.

sa: एहि गच्छ मया भीष्म युद्धकामुद दुर्मद। गृहाण सर्वं कौरव्य रथादि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Come and let us go together, O Bhishma, who are hard to vanquish in battle and desirous of war; take, O son of Kuru, your chariots etc. O foremost among the Bharatas,

sa: अर्थं वा यदि वा धर्म समर्थो देशकालवित्। अर्थसंशयमापन्नः श्रेयान्निः संशयो नरः॥
en: When one, able to discriminate the propriety of time and place and knowing both virtue and worldly good, is doubtful of his course, he should without hesitation do that which is virtuous.

sa: तस्मिंस्त्वभिहते राजन् हतोत्साहा हतौजसः। यतिष्यन्ते न राज्याय स हि तेषां व्यपाश्रयः॥
en: O king, on his death all the others (the Pandavas) will be deprived of strength and energy. Deprived of him, who is their mainstay, they will not attempt to regain their kingdom.

sa: सुतां काश्यस्य कौरव्य मत्प्रियार्थं महामते। न हि ते विद्यते शान्तिरन्यथा कुरुनन्दन॥
en: The daughter of the king of the Kashis for my gratification, O son of Kuru, endued with great intelligence. There is no other way of gratifying me, O delighter of Kuru's race.

sa: स उपाध्यायेन संदिष्ट आरुणिः पाञ्चाल्यस्तत्र गत्वा तम्, केदारखण्डं बर्द्ध नाशकत्। क्लिश्यमानोऽपश्यदुपायम् भवत्वेवं करिष्यामि॥ स तत्र संविवेश केदारखण्डे। शयाने च तथा तस्मिंस्तदुदकं तस्थौ॥
en: Thus ordered by the preceptor, Aruni of Panchala went to the spot, but could not stop the breach. He was very sorry that he could not carry out his preceptor's bidding, but at last he saw a means and he said, “I shall do it in this way." He entered into the breach and there laid himself down and thus the water was stopped.

sa: न कृष्णा राजपुत्री च नरकारे कथंचन। एह्येहि भरतश्रेष्ठ पश्य गङ्गां त्रिलोकगाम्॥
en: The Princes Krishna too, O Yudhishthira, could not be deserving of that place of sinners, Come, come, O foremost of the Bharatas see Ganga, who spreads her current over the three worlds.

sa: महद्धि परमं भूतं यत् प्रपश्यन्ति योगिनः। अबुधास्तं न पश्यन्ति ह्यात्मस्थं गुणबुद्धयः॥
en: High indeed is that self-existent Essence which Yogins witness. They who are devoid of wisdom, and whose understandings are addicted to worldly objects never see that which exists in the soul itself.

sa: इदमिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तत्त्वेन द्विजसत्तम॥ कुवलाश्व इति ख्यात इक्ष्वाकुरपराजितः। कथं नामविपर्यासाद् धुन्धुमारत्वमागतः॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, I desire to hear from you all these accounts. Why did that invincible descendant of Ikshvaku, known by the name of Kuvalashva change and assume another, namely Dhundhumara?

sa: स धर्मकुशलो राजा मोक्षशास्त्रविशारदः। याज्यो मम स यद् ब्रूयात् तत् कार्यमविशङ्कया॥
en: That king is well versed in all duties and well acquainted with the Scriptures on Liberation. He is one for whom I officiate in sacrifices. You should, unhesitatingly, do what he orders.

sa: न मे गर्वितमायस्तं सहिष्यति दुरात्मवान्। कृतं तारे सहायत्वं दर्शितं सौहृदं मयि॥
en: Forsooth, that vicious-souled one shall not be able to withstand my pride and proficient skill in warfare. O Tārā, you had already displayed your attachment to me by giving me good counsels.

sa: रूपं महत् ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं महाबाहो बहुबाहुरुपादम्। बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं दृष्ट्वा लोकाः परव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्॥
en: O mighty-armed, all creatures frightened, and I am seeing also your mighty form with many mouths and eyes, with innumerable arms, things, feet and bellies, and terrible on account of many tusks.

sa: न तु शक्यमपक्रोशं पृथिव्यां दातुमात्मनः। एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही क्रोधात् सुपरुषं वचः॥
en: And I shall not be able to bring blame on myself in this world. having said these harsh words in wrath, Videha's daughter, Janaki, did not there again say anything to Rāvaņa.

sa: भीमनादं सुताम्राष्ठं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं महाबलम्। महेष्वासं महावीर्यं महासत्त्वं महाभुजम्॥ महाजवं महाकायं महामायमरिंदमम्। दीर्घघोणं महोरस्कं विकटोबद्धपिण्डिकम्॥ अमानुषं मानुषजं भीमवेगं महाबलम्। यः पिशाचनतीत्यान्यान् बभूवातीव राक्षसान्॥
en: Of roaring voice, of lips brown as copper, of teeth sharp and keen. He was mighty armed, greatly energetic, exceedingly powerful and a great car warrior. Having long nose, broad chest, frightfully swelling calves, celerity of motion and excessive strength, he had nothing human in him, though born of a man. He excelled all the Pishachas and other such creatures and also the Rakshasas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सन्नादयशक्रो दिवं भूमिं च सर्वशः। रथेनोपययौ पार्थमारोहेत्यब्रवीच्च तम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Causing the Heaven and the Earth to be filled by a loud sound, then Shakra came to the son of Pritha on a car and asked him to ascend it.

sa: त्यक्त्वा महीत्वं भूमिस्तु स्पर्धयाङ्गनृपस्य ह। नाश जगाम तां विप्रो व्यस्तम्भयत कश्यपः॥
en: Formerly, the Earth, indulging in a spirit of rivalry with the king of the Angas, forsook her character as Earth. The regenerate Kashyapa caused destruction to befall her by actually paralysing her.

sa: तस्य देवस्य यद् वक्त्रं समुद्रे तदधिष्ठितम्। वडवामुखेति विक्ष्यातं पिबत् तोयमयं हविः॥
en: What is known as the mouth of that god is the ocean; and it is well-known that assuming the form of the sea-fire it drinks the libations in the shape of water.

sa: श्रान्तस्य ते क्षुधार्तस्य चिन्तयानस्य तत् सुखम्। वने घोरे महाराज नाशयिष्याम्यहं क्लमम्॥
en: O illustrious sovereign! when fatigued with toil and oppressed with hunger in the midst of this dreary wilderness, you shall remember your former happiness, then shall I solace you in your troubles.

sa: ये त्वां प्रोत्साहयन्त्येते नैते कृत्याय कर्हिचित्। वैरं परेषां ग्रीवायां प्रतिमोक्ष्यन्ति संयुगे।॥
en: Those, who are now encouraging and supporting you, will hardly do any thing when the time comes; and they rather will throw the (act of bearing) hostilities on the shoulders of others.

sa: नाहं विना यदुभिर्यादवानां पुरीमिमामशकं द्रष्टुमद्य॥ तपश्चरिष्यामि निबोध तन्मे रामेण सार्धं वनमभ्युपेत्य।
en: It is impossible for me to see this city of the Yadavs without the Yadus beside me. Know that going to the forest I shall practice penances with Rama in my company.

sa: स तत्तदा सूर्य इवाभ्रजालं प्रविश्य रक्षोधिपतेर्निवेशनम्। ददर्श दूरेऽग्रजमासनस्थं स्वयंभुवं शक्र इवासनस्थम्।४।।
en: Entering the mansion of the Raksasa sovereign, like the sun entering into a mass of clouds, he saw his elder brother seated at a distance; even as Sakra sees the Self-sprung seated.

sa: अनु त्वां तात जीवन्तु ब्राह्मणाः सुहृदस्तथा। पर्जन्यमिव भूतानि देवा इव शतक्रतुम्॥
en: May the Brahmanas and your wellwishers, my son, live depend on you as living creatures depend on the clouds (rain) and as the gods depend on the performer of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: शरीरस्यापि मोक्षाय स्वयं प्राप्य महाफलम्। त्वमेव भविता भर्ता स्वर्गस्यापि न संशयः॥
en: In which you can obtain the salvation of your body, you may obtain heaven as your reward. As the great fruit (of your action) you can certainly become the lord of heaven.

sa: साधर्मभीता परिचन्तयन्ती तां याज्ञसेनी परमप्रतीताम्। पाणौ गृहीत्वोपजगाम कुन्ती युधिष्ठिरे वाक्यमुवाच चेदम्॥
en: Being anxious with the fear of sin and reflecting how every one could be extricated from the situation, she took the cheerful Yajnaseni by the hand and coming to Yudhishthira, she said.

sa: अथवा मद्विनाशोऽयं न हि शक्ष्यामि कंचन। परित्यक्तुमहं बन्धं स्वयं जीवन् नृशंसवत्॥
en: Oh, how can I bear it? The time has come for my own death. I shall not be able to live like a cruel wretch by abandoning my own relatives and friends.

sa: हत्वा च रावणं संख्ये सीतामाहृत्य राघवः। अमर्ष पृष्ठतः कृत्वा स्ववेश्म पुनरानयत्॥
en: Having discomfitted Rāvana, in the encounter Rāma has released Şītā, but not being the least enraged on account of her being touched by Rāvaņa he has brought to her his own city.

sa: त्वदर्शनकृतस्नेहं मनश्चलति मे भृशम्। न त्वां दृष्ट्वा पुनश्चान्यां द्रष्टुं कल्याणि रोचते॥
en: O blessed beauty, at the very first sight, my heart has been captivated by you. My mind wanders. Seeing you, I do not like to cast my eyes on any other woman.

sa: ततो वेदविदस्तात सदस्याः सर्व एव तम्। राजानमूचुः सहिता लभतां ब्राह्मणो वरम्॥
en: Thereupon, all the Sadasyas, learned in the Vedas, told the king in one voice, in the Vedas, told the king in one voice, “Let the Brahmana receive the boon (asked by him.")

sa: कच्चिदर्थेन वा धर्मं धर्मेणार्थमथापि वा। उभौ वा प्रीतिसारेण न कामेन प्रबाधसे॥
en: Do you injure religion (Dharma) for the sake of profit (Artha), or profit for the sake of religion, or both religion and profit for the sake of pleasures which easily tempts men?

sa: इति मत्वा प्रियं पुत्रं भीष्मादाय ततो ह्यहम्। पूर्वस्नेहानुरागित्वात् सदारः सौमकिं गतः॥
en: O Bhishma, thus resolved and remembering my former friendship for him (Drupada) I regarded myself very much blessed. I went joyfully to the Saumaka, taking my beloved son and wife with me.

sa: स हि निर्जित्य निर्जित्य पार्थिवान् पृतनागतान्। पुरमानीय बद्धवा च चकार पुरुषव्रजम्॥
en: By defeating all the kings, one after the other and their soldiers, he has brought them all as prisoners to his city; and he has thus daily swelled the crowd (of kings).

sa: सोऽयं ते बन्धुकामाया अशृण्वत्या वचो मम। बन्धुप्रणाशः सम्प्राप्तो भृशं दुःखकरो मम॥
en: From you affection towards your relatives and friends, you did not then listen to my words. The great misery for the loss of a relative and friend has now come to us.

sa: श्रोतुं पात्रं च राजंस्त्वं प्राप्येमा भारती कथाम्। गुरोर्वक्त्रपरिस्पन्दो मनः प्रोत्साहयतीव मे॥
en: O king, you are a proper person to hear the history of Bharata. I feel no fear to perform this great act (reciting the Bharata) encouraged as I am by my preceptor.

sa: मृते पितरि ते वीरा वनादेत्य स्वमन्दिरम्। नचिरादेव विद्वांसो वेदे धनुषि चाभवन्॥
en: On the death of their father, these heroes (the Pandavas) came back to their own home from the forest. They became experts in the science of archery within a very short time.

sa: आवाहयामि कं देवं ब्रूहि सत्यवतां वर। त्वत्तोऽनुज्ञाप्रतीक्षां मां विद्ध्यस्मिन् कर्मणि स्थिताम्॥
en: By that Mantra to rise up good offspring. O royal sage, O foremost of truthful men, tell me which of the celestials I shall call. Know, wait your commands in this matter.

sa: ततः स नृपतिश्रेष्ठो रक्षसापहतेन्द्रियः। उवाच शक्तिं तं दृष्ट्वा न चिरादिव भारत॥
